name: JV_OPERATIONAL_MEASURES
description: This table contains the operational measures for joint ventures. These measures are used to allocate expenses and calculate overhead for joint ventures.

columns.name: OPERATIONAL_MEASURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture operational measure.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MEASURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the operational measure type that the measure value is associated with.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture that the operational measure is associated with.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: The primary segment value that the operational measure is associated with.

columns.name: MEASURE_REFERENCE
columns.description: A reference related to the operational measure that identifies the source such as equipment number, flight type, supplier, etc.

columns.name: MEASURE_DATE
columns.description: The date that the operational measure was taken.

columns.name: MEASURE_VALUE
columns.description: The value of the operational measure.

columns.name: MEASURE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code to identify the state of the joint venture operational measure. It is based on the ORA_JV_OP_MEASURE_STATUS lookup codes like Available to Process, Process Complete, and so forth.

columns.name: MEASURE_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the type of operational measure line. It is based on ORA_JV_OP_MEASURE_LINE_CODE lookup codes such as Original, Canceled, and Reversed.

columns.name: MEASURE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number which will be incremented as an operational measure is entered, canceled, or reversed.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the accounting header ID of the statistical journal entry created for the joint venture operational measure.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
